question: Should `talk.idleTimeoutS` apply to manually started Talk sessions as well as Voice Wake-started sessions?
rationale: Both entry paths converge on the same runtime, so the branch's general public setting affects both even though the motivating workflow is automatic return to Voice Wake.

options.title: Voice Wake sessions only
options.body: Add an explicit activation-origin contract and apply idle expiry only to Talk sessions started by Voice Wake.

options.title: All Talk sessions
options.body: Keep the current general setting and document that configured manually started Talk sessions also auto-deactivate.

recommendation.title: Voice Wake sessions only
recommendation.body: Add an explicit activation-origin contract and apply idle expiry only to Talk sessions started by Voice Wake.

likelyOwner.reason: Current Talk runtime and config history make Peter the strongest available owner for this permanent product contract.
